about_the_game:
CINESCAPE-VR is a puzzle game that invites you to explore a variety of themed film studios. Thanks to your unique power, Cinemorphosis, you can turn real objects into fake props and vice versa. This power evolves and grows stronger as your adventure progresses. A series of intricate puzzles awaits you, increasing in complexity the further you advance.

Features : 

  • Intuitive controls – literally. No controllers needed: your own hands are enough, thanks to hand tracking (if supported by your headset) !

  • Your companion throughout the adventure is P4-TRIC, a robotic assistant built by the former director of the studios. He’s here to guide you through the tests… but behind his advice and encouragement may lie a hidden plan..

  • As your journey unfolds, a deeper truth emerges. You may not be who you thought you were, and the studio’s founder may have had far more personal reasons for designing these trials.

  • Dive into the adventure. Wield your new power – CINEMORPHOSIS – and uncover the mysteries of the studios..

  • Each environment is filled with subtle cinematic references, carefully placed for film buffs to discover.

Your mission? Restore the Codex and uncover the secrets it holds by following in the footsteps of its mysterious creator.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR. Standing or Room Scale
  • Additional Notes: Minimum 72Hz VR support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • VR Support: OpenXR. Standing or Room Scale
  • Additional Notes: Minimum 72Hz VR support

short_description: CINESCAPE-VR is a virtual reality escape game where you must solve puzzles within film studio sets, using the power of Cinemorphosis – a unique ability that lets you transform the objects around you – to uncover the secrets of the Cinetech company.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
